author: SickProdigy
description: A unified free-play game room with dice, coin flips, blackjack, higher-or-lower, high card, pass-line craps, optional Red bank wagers, and discovery of Red's native games.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-server wager settings, bounded virtual-currency transaction records, and per-member daily loss totals. Completed records are anonymized on user deletion; unresolved financial records are retained until reconciled.
install_msg: Open the game room with `[p]games`. Try `[p]dice d20`, `[p]coinflip`, `[p]blackjack`, or `[p]higherlower`, or `[p]highcard`.
name: GameRoom
short: Unified free-play dice and card games
